title: Factory Manager
description:
**Company Description**
AMPLE FOODS LIMITED is a food production company headquartered in Birmingham, United Kingdom, specializing in the manufacturing of food products for diverse markets. The company operates from 62 Cherry Orchard Road, Handsworth Wood, in the West Midlands region. AMPLE FOODS LIMITED focuses on consistent product quality and reliable supply, serving customers who demand safe and dependable food solutions. Team members are encouraged to contribute to efficient operations and continuous improvement within a structured, process-driven environment.
  
**Role Description**
The Factory Manager role at AMPLE FOODS LIMITED is a full-time, on-site position based in Manesar. The Factory Manager will oversee daily manufacturing operations, including production planning, resource allocation, and workflow optimization to meet output and delivery targets. Responsibilities include monitoring quality standards, enforcing food safety and regulatory compliance, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives across the facility. The role involves managing and mentoring factory teams, coordinating with procurement, logistics, and maintenance, and ensuring equipment reliability and workplace safety. The Factory Manager will also analyze production data, prepare reports for leadership, and support cost control and efficiency projects.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess skills in Production Planning and Production Management to manage capacity, schedules, and output.
* Candidates should possess skills in Quality Control and Manufacturing Operations to maintain product standards and process reliability.
* Candidates should possess skills in Operations Management to oversee end-to-end factory performance and resource utilization.
* Experience in food manufacturing or FMCG production environments, with knowledge of food safety and regulatory requirements (e.g., HACCP, ISO standards).
* Strong leadership, team management, and conflict-resolution abilities, with a focus on safety and collaboration.
* Ability to analyze data, use production metrics, and apply problem-solving and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, 5S).
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to coordinate with cross-functional teams and external partners.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Food Technology, Operations Management, or a related field; relevant professional certifications are an advantage.

title: Plant Manager
description:
About the Role

HFC India Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a skilled and experienced Plant Manager to oversee and manage plant-level fire safety operations, with a primary focus on FAPS (Fire Alarm and Protection Systems) and FDSS (Fire Detection and Suppression Systems).

The ideal candidate will be responsible for supervising installation, commissioning, maintenance, team coordination, quality control, and ensuring that all fire safety systems operate efficiently and comply with applicable safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage and supervise day-to-day plant operations related to FAPS and FDSS.
* Oversee installation, testing, commissioning, inspection, and maintenance of fire alarm, detection, and suppression systems.
* Ensure proper functioning, reliability, and operational readiness of all fire safety equipment.
* Coordinate with plant management, engineers, technicians, contractors, and clients.
* Monitor preventive maintenance schedules and ensure timely resolution of system faults.
* Ensure compliance with applicable fire safety standards, site safety procedures, and statutory requirements.
* Maintain technical documentation, inspection reports, maintenance records, and system performance reports.
* Identify operational risks and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Manage manpower, materials, tools, and resources efficiently.
* Conduct safety briefings and ensure technicians follow appropriate work and safety procedures.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
* Relevant experience in fire safety systems, industrial plant operations, or fire protection engineering.
* Practical knowledge of fire alarm systems, fire detection systems, and fire suppression systems.
* Experience in installation, troubleshooting, testing, commissioning, and preventive maintenance.
* Strong leadership, team management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple site activities and maintain technical documentation.

Preferred Experience

* Experience working in industrial plants, factories, warehouses, or other industrial facilities.
* Knowledge of applicable fire safety standards, including relevant NBC and NFPA requirements.
* Experience coordinating with clients, vendors, contractors, and technical teams.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resume with HFC India Pvt. Ltd.

Email: info@hfcfire.com

Contact: +91 8295553541

Join our team and contribute to safer industrial operations through reliable fire safety solutions.
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Plant Manager role located in Hodal. The Plant Manager is responsible for overseeing daily plant operations, including production planning, manufacturing processes, resource allocation, and adherence to safety and quality standards. The role involves managing plant staff, coordinating cross-functional teams, monitoring equipment and facility performance, and ensuring compliance with relevant regulations and company policies. The Plant Manager will track operational KPIs, drive process improvements, optimize costs, and support timely delivery of projects and products. This role also requires effective communication with senior management and other stakeholders to report performance, address issues, and implement corrective actions.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Plant Management and Plant Operations to oversee end-to-end functioning of the facility.
* Candidates should possess skills in Operations Management and Production Planning to optimize workflows, schedules, and resource utilization.
* Candidates should possess skills in Manufacturing Operations to maintain quality, safety, and efficiency in production activities.
* Relevant experience in industrial or manufacturing environments, preferably in fire protection or related engineering sectors.
* Knowledge of safety regulations, compliance standards, and quality management systems.
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams, manage performance, and resolve operational issues.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Excellent communication and organizational skills; ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Production Management, or a related technical field; advanced qualifications are an advantage.

title: Farm Manager Aquaculture
description:
**Company Description**

Affy Parenterals is a certified pharmaceutical manufacturing company based in Baddi, Himachal Pradesh, India, with over 28 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry. The company operates multiple manufacturing units along with printing and packaging units, producing over 8,000 pharmaceutical brands for more than 1,000 customers worldwide. Affy specialises in a wide range of pharmaceutical formulations, focusing on delivering quality products at affordable prices. Key product categories include oncology, injectables, soft and hard gelatin capsules, tablets, nutraceuticals, and diagnostic solutions. Going forward, Affy Group is expanding its horizon into the Aquaculture & Agriculture Industry, leveraging its extensive manufacturing expertise to drive innovation and diversification.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a highly skilled and dedicated Farm Manager to oversee our advanced aquaculture operations in Ujina, Haryana. This is a full-time, on-site role, located in Ujina, Haryana (District-Nuh), which is pivotal in managing the end-to-end production of Pangasius, Tilapia, Sea Bass, Shrimp, Rohu, and Scampi using cutting-edge technology, specifically In-Pond Raceway Systems (IPRS) and Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS). The ideal candidate will be a hands-on leader with deep technical expertise in intensive fish farming, biological monitoring, and system maintenance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Production Management: Oversee the complete lifecycle, from fingerling stocking and grading to harvesting and post-harvest logistics.
* System Oversight: Manage and optimise the daily operations of IPRS and RAS, ensuring peak efficiency of filtration, aeration, and water circulation components.
* Water Quality Monitoring: Conduct rigorous daily testing of water parameters (DO, pH, Ammonia, Nitrates, Temperature) and implement immediate corrective actions to maintain an optimal environment.
* Biosecurity & Health: Implement strict biosecurity protocols to prevent disease outbreaks. Diagnose fish health issues and manage feeding regimes to maximise Growth Rate (SGR) and minimise Food Conversion Ratio (FCR).
* Inventory & Data Logging: Maintain meticulous records of feed consumption, growth charts, mortality rates, and chemical usage. Manage procurement of farm inputs.
* Team Leadership: Supervise and train on-site farm labourers and technicians, ensuring a culture of safety and precision.
* Maintenance: Coordinate routine and emergency repairs for pumps, blowers, sensors, and backup power systems to ensure 24/7 operational continuity.

If you feel like you fit the role and are excited to take on this opportunity, please share your CV and a brief cover letter at - Email Address - anshika@affygroup.com, mentioning
*“Farm Manager - Aquaculture”*
in the subject line. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and will reach out to the shortlisted candidates.

title: HVAC Engineer (O&M)
description:
**Job Description:** 
 HVAC Engineer, Operations and Maintenance
 



**Position** 
 :
 **HVAC Engineer, Operations and Maintenance** 




**Department** 
 : Infrastructure Campus Operations \& Estate Development
 



**Experience** 
 :
 **Minimum of 12 plus years of relevant experience in HVAC operations and maintenance,** 
 preferably in large institutional, university, commercial, hospitality, residential, or integrated campus environments.
 



**Qualification** 
 :
 **Diploma or B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering** 




 Additional certification in HVAC, refrigeration, energy management, or facilities management will be an advantage.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 
 The HVAC Engineer will be responsible for the
 **operation, maintenance, performance monitoring, and reliable functioning of HVAC systems across the campus** 
 . The role will ensure comfortable indoor temperatures, uninterrupted chilled water supply, timely preventive and corrective maintenance, effective vendor management, and minimum equipment downtime.
 



 The position will work closely with internal technical teams, external vendors, contractors, and campus stakeholders to ensure that all HVAC assets operate safely, efficiently, and at their designed capacity.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. HVAC Operations and Performance
 


1. Ensure comfortable indoor temperatures of
 **23°C to 25°C** 
 across designated campus facilities, based on occupancy, weather conditions, and operational requirements.
2. Monitor and manage the operation of
 **chillers, AHUs, FCUs, ventilation systems, pumps, cooling towers, ventilation equipment, and associated HVAC systems** 
 .
3. Ensure reliable chilled water supply to support the efficient operation of air conditioning systems installed across workspaces, academic buildings, administrative facilities, residences, and other designated areas.
4. Monitor HVAC equipment performance and identify deviations, abnormal operating conditions, and potential equipment failures.
5. Ensure all fixed HVAC systems, excluding student hostels where separately assigned, operate at their designed capacity and are maintained as per recommended standards.
6. Monitor energy consumption and equipment performance to identify opportunities for improved operational efficiency.



 2\. Preventive and Corrective Maintenance
 


1. Develop, implement, and monitor
 **preventive, predictive, corrective, and periodic maintenance schedules** 
 for HVAC systems.
2. Ensure timely servicing, inspection, cleaning, calibration, and replacement of components to maintain equipment reliability.
3. Conduct preventive maintenance of
 **FCUs and AHUs in Student Hostels SH 11, SH 12, and SH 14** 
 .
4. Attend and coordinate the resolution of HVAC breakdowns and technical failures within defined SLA timelines.
5. Maintain adequate stock of
 **critical HVAC spare parts, consumables, and essential maintenance materials** 
 to minimize equipment downtime.
6. Analyse recurring breakdowns and recommend appropriate corrective measures to prevent repeated failures.
7. Ensure proper maintenance records are maintained for all major HVAC equipment and systems.



 3\. Chiller Plant Management
 


1. Maintain daily operational logs for chiller plants, including operating parameters, temperatures, pressures, running hours, alarms, and other relevant performance indicators.
2. Monitor chiller plant efficiency and identify abnormal trends requiring servicing or corrective action.
3. Coordinate scheduled servicing and major maintenance activities for chillers, pumps, cooling towers, and associated equipment.
4. Ensure timely escalation of critical equipment issues and coordinate with specialized service agencies wherever required.



 4\. Vendor and AMC Management
 


1. Coordinate with HVAC vendors and service agencies for
 **Annual Maintenance Contracts, breakdown support, equipment servicing, installation, testing, and commissioning** 
 .
2. Monitor vendor performance against agreed SLAs, maintenance schedules, and contractual requirements.
3. Verify service reports, work completion, site measurements, and equipment performance before recommending vendor payments.
4. Coordinate with vendors during installation and commissioning of new HVAC equipment and ensure compliance with approved specifications.
5. Maintain proper documentation related to AMC agreements, service reports, breakdowns, warranties, and equipment history.



 5\. Complaint and SLA Management
 


1. Monitor HVAC related complaints received from occupants, faculty, staff, and other campus users.
2. Ensure complaints are assigned, attended to, and resolved within defined
 **SLA timelines** 
 .
3. Coordinate with technicians and vendors for timely resolution of recurring or technically complex complaints.
4. Analyse complaint trends and recommend improvements to reduce recurring HVAC issues.



 6\. Hostel Technical Services
 


1. Initially oversee technical services in designated student hostels, including
 **HVAC, electrical, plumbing, civil, and carpentry\-related requirements** 
 , in coordination with the respective teams.
2. Subsequently focus primarily on
 **HVAC Operations and Maintenance for student hostels** 
 as responsibilities are transitioned to the relevant technical teams.
3. Ensure preventive and corrective maintenance of HVAC systems in designated hostels and maintain service records.
4. Ensure timely availability of materials, tools, spare parts, and manpower required for hostel HVAC maintenance.



 7\. Documentation, BOQ and Commercial Coordination
 


1. Prepare and review
 **BOQs, material indents, technical specifications, estimates, and site measurements** 
 related to HVAC works.
2. Process and verify vendor invoices based on completed work, service reports, approved BOQs, and actual site measurements.
3. Maintain accurate records of equipment inventories, maintenance history, breakdowns, spare parts, AMC activities, and service schedules.
4. Support budgeting and procurement activities for HVAC maintenance, replacement, and improvement projects.



 8\. Team Management and Training
 


1. Supervise and coordinate HVAC technicians, operators, and ground\-level technical staff.
2. Train ground staff on the
 **safe and proper operation, basic troubleshooting, and routine maintenance of HVAC equipment** 
 .
3. Verify staff attendance, work allocation, productivity, and performance.
4. Ensure technicians follow approved safety procedures, maintenance practices, and operational protocols.
5. Conduct regular toolbox talks and technical briefings wherever required.



  





**Preferred Experience: E** 
 xperience in
 **large universities, institutional campuses, hospitals, hotels, commercial complexes, residential facilities, or other large\-scale facilities** 
 with centralized HVAC and chilled water systems will be preferred.

 **overall management of student housing operations during the night shift** 
 , with primary accountability for
 **student safety, emergency response, and operational continuity** 
 .
 



  





 The position requires a strong
 **security and operations background** 
 and the ability to independently manage critical situations, lead night\-shift teams, coordinate with multiple support functions, and ensure strict adherence to Company / University policies and Student Housing SOPs.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Night Operations \& Student Safety** 



* Take overall responsibility for night\-time operations across assigned student residences.
* Conduct regular rounds of hostel buildings, common areas, entry/exit points and other critical areas.
* Ensure compliance with Student Housing policies, safety procedures and operational SOPs.
* Maintain a safe, secure and disciplined residential environment.



**2\. Incident \& Emergency Management** 



* Act as the senior on\-ground responder for significant night\-time incidents.
* Manage and coordinate response to:
* Medical emergencies
* Fire and life\-safety incidents
* Theft or suspected theft
* Security breaches
* Student conflicts and disturbances
* Unauthorized entry
* Property damage
* Missing/welfare\-related concerns
* Critical engineering or infrastructure failures
* Coordinate with Security, Wardens, Medical Centre, Engineering and University leadership.
* Ensure timely escalation, containment, documentation and follow\-up of incidents.



**4\. Student \& Conflict Management** 



* Maintain a professional, calm and approachable presence while dealing with students.
* Handle student concerns and conflicts with maturity and sensitivity.
* De\-escalate difficult situations and ensure student safety.
* Maintain confidentiality in sensitive student\-related matters.



**5\. Coordination with Technical Services** 



* Coordinate with the night Engineering / Technical Services team for critical issues relating to HVAC, electrical, plumbing, lifts, water supply, fire systems and other essential services.
* Ensure critical complaints are responded to within defined timelines.
* Escalate unresolved or high\-risk technical issues to the appropriate leadership.



**6\. Team Leadership** 



* Supervise and coordinate night\-shift Housekeeping and Technical Services personnel.
* Ensure manpower deployment as per approved roster.
* Monitor discipline, grooming, attendance and professional conduct.
* Conduct periodic surprise checks and operational audits.
* Ensure effective coordination among all night\-shift functions.



**7\. Reporting \& Handover** 



* Maintain a comprehensive Night Shift Operations \& Incident Log.
* Prepare daily night\-shift reports covering incidents, security observations, student concerns, emergencies and operational issues.
* Ensure complete handover of open and critical matters to the day team.
* Maintain accurate and confidential incident records.
